title: Rhythm Heaven browser game manifest v1

icon.description: Original game-select texture, imported locally from layout_gameSelect.szs.

iconArt.description: For a game without an original game-select icon: one cell of its own converted cell animations over a colour the game uses, inside an original icon's frame (tools/extract-menu.py).

crop.description: Left, top, right, bottom as fractions of the cell's bounds.

offset.description: Shift in icon pixels: right, down.

texture.description: A converted texture in the game's assets folder; pixel picks the colour.

input.description: Input type the cues wait for (EInputType): 4 A (default), 6 A and B together.

music.description: A remix: the backing track (wave sound name) whose chart switches between scenes.

scenes.description: A remix's scenes: each another manifest's game (its code, banks and profile), with the cellanim archive the remix version loads.

epilogue.description: The epilogue cell animation archive, when not beside the game's cellanim.

sceneOnly.description: A scene only a remix changes to (Remix 10's navigator): it has no chart of its own, so it is never built or hosted on its own.

extraCellanims.description: Other games' cellanim archives the scene also loads (the navigator's metronome); their banks join the scene's.

results.description: false: the game has no results screen or epilogue (Night Walk, the credits game, ends on the staff credits).

calibration.description: The rhythm test: the browser measures the presses against the beats its signal sound plays on (SE_CHECK_CLICK, not the visual timer's zero) and saves them as the audio delay.

messageLayout.description: The game's own layout whose text boxes the chart's message panes use (Hole in One's CMyLayout, the lyric layout's lines in Cheer Readers); the shared speech balloon needs no entry.

font.description: Index of the layout's font its message text boxes use (default 0).

lyricLayout.description: The scene's lyric layout (CExScene +0x18) when the game's own layout is another (Night Walk's sky): the vocal song's title card.

animations.description: [pane, animation] bindings in the order the game's setup makes them; a third item may make the binding not recursive or stand for count numbered panes (a pane name with %02d).

anyOf.description: count numbered panes (a pane name with %02d)

hidden.description: Panes the game's layout setup hides.

messages.description: The messages its texts show: main (riq_E.bmg, the default) or bonus (riq_bonus_E.bmg, a vocal song's title card).

screen.description: The layout is drawn only into the game's dynamic texture, shown by its screen bank (Shrimp Shuffle's shore); additive lists the panes whose alpha pass adds.
